title: Make It Bad. Make It Anyway.
excerpt: A case for making things without chasing perfection.
content:
Artists and creative people need a space to play around without the pressure of external standards telling them what the “right” or “wrong” choice is, allowing themselves to fuck up, learn from it, and move on.

That is, make more “Jank” stuff.

By “Jank,” I mean imperfect art. Art that isn’t trying to prove how skilled we are.

I know that if I spend a lifetime sculpting marble, I could eventually reach Michelangelo-level power mode.

But if I follow that route, to be satisfied, I have to keep practicing, studying, following tutorials, refining my technique, and chasing that level of mastery.

I don’t want that.

There are some things that I want to be good at: scripting and audio storytelling. I feel confident in scripting, and I do have a good mic. Now, the only thing that holds me back is... visuals.

But now, if my goal is to produce “Jank,” I don’t have to worry about making it perfect.

Which means I could just make things and release them, without spending an eternity making them look “right.”

And that would help me realize my goal of just making things.

title: My Creator Manifesto
excerpt: I have decided to start a YouTube channel. Through this manifesto, I am setting up a list of directions to follow for myself.
content:
# My Creator Manifesto

I have decided to start a YouTube channel. Through this manifesto, I am setting up a list of directions to follow for myself.

**1) I shall use AI as a research partner only.**

I am allowed to use AI for research purposes: to explore and study things, to explore new ideas and all.

However, I shall craft all the writing myself.

The words should come from me.

(I can use AI to fix my grammar mistakes, though.)

**2) I shall make my own art.**

I should aim for making all the art handcrafted by myself. It is my brand; hence it should reflect my identity.

**3) The goal is to have fun.**

Every process of creating the video should feel joyful. If I don't feel joy, then I should change the process to a manner in which I feel joy.

**4) Make for the 18-year-old me.**

The storytelling should be such that a person who is in Class 10 should be able to understand it and fall in love with it.

**5) Credit Everyone**

I should credit everyone whose works helped me during my creative pursuit.

For I am nothing without them.

"If I have seen further [than others], it is by standing on the shoulders of giants." - Sir Isaac Newton
